entries.speaker: Going to the Jazz Club
entries.en: Team members you invite to the Jazz Club will have[n]their Personas strengthened, as well as receiving[n]other helpful effects. These effects differ depending[n]on what day of the week you visit.

entries.speaker: Going to the Jazz Club
entries.en: If you visit the Jazz Club on a day when [clr 2]a live[n]singer performs[clr 27], a special cocktail will be[n]served. Also, the [clr 2]effects of the cocktail will[n]be doubled[clr 27] if it's a weekday.
